# VideoTimeline

**Class:** `UltraCanvasVideoTimeline` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVideoTimeline.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVideoTimeline.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasVideoTimeline.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A media timeline to edit: clips on tracks under a time ruler, trim, reorder, split, transitions, markers, beat marks, a playhead; every edit reported to the app, never applied

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasTheme](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTheme.md)
- [UltraCanvasTimecodeField](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTimecodeField.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasVideoTimeline> CreateVideoTimeline(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
UCElementDescriptor MakeVideoTimelineDescriptor();
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasVideoTimeline(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onChangeRequested` | `std::function<bool(const TimelineChange&)> onChangeRequested` | The app validates, applies to its document and calls SetModel. A handler returning false means the edit was refused; the element then shows the model as it is. With no handler every edit is refused. |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>& clipIds)> onSelectionChanged` | _Selection changed_ |
| `onPlayheadChanged` | `std::function<void(double seconds)> onPlayheadChanged` | the user moved it |
| `onRangeChanged` | `std::function<void(double in, double out)> onRangeChanged` | I / O keys |
| `onClipActivated` | `std::function<void(const std::string& clipId)> onClipActivated` | double-click |
| `onTransitionActivated` | `std::function<void(const std::string& clipId)> onTransitionActivated` | double-click the badge |
| `onMarkerActivated` | `std::function<void(const TimelineMarker& marker)> onMarkerActivated` | double-click on the ruler |
| `onFilesDropped` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>& files, const std::string& trackId, double seconds)> onFilesDropped` | _Files dropped_ |
| `onContextMenuRequested` | `std::function<void(const std::string& trackId, double seconds, const std::string& clipId, int windowX, int windowY)> onContextMenuRequested` | _Context menu requested_ |
| `onTrackToggled` | `std::function<void(const std::string& trackId, TimelineTrackToggle toggle, bool on)> onTrackToggled` | _Track toggled_ |
| `onZoomChanged` | `std::function<void(double pixelsPerSecond)> onZoomChanged` | _Zoom changed_ |
| `onToolChanged` | `std::function<void(TimelineTool tool)> onToolChanged` | _Tool changed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

### struct `DropFeedback`

What the element shows for a drop the application carries itself (a title style or an effect dragged from its bin), one call per pointer move: the clip it would land on, ringed as SetDropTargetClip rings it, and the lane and time it would land at, with the insertion line and readout the element draws for files it is handed - the time snapped as a file drop is (the nearest cut on a magnetic track, the snap points otherwise), the readout "<label> at <timecode>". Either part may be empty. Returns the snapped time of the marker, -1 without one (a track not in the model shows no marker). ClearDropFeedback, or a DragLeave event, takes both away.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `clipId` | `std::string clipId` | the clip to ring, "" for none |
| `trackId` | `std::string trackId` | the lane of the insertion marker, "" for none |
| `seconds` | `double seconds = 0.0` | where on it |
| `label` | `std::string label` | the readout's name for what is dropped |
